keyPoints: Swasthya ka matlab sirf bimari na hona nahi hai, balki sharirik, mansik aur samajik roop se poori tarah theek-thaak hona hai — yehi WHO ki paribhasha hai.
Santulit aahar, saaf paani, roz vyayam aur poori neend achhe swasthya ke chaar stambh hain; inme se ek bhi kamzor ho to sehat bigadti hai.
Sankramak rog sukshm jeevon (jivanu, vishanu) se failte hain — khaansi-chheenk me muh dhakna, haath dhona aur bheed se doori bachav ke saral upaay hain.
Teeka (vaccine) sharir ko bimari se ladne ki taakat deta hai; polio ka unmoolan aur chechak ka khatma teekakaran ki jeet ke saboot hain.
Saaf-safai, kachre ka sahi nipatara aur shauchalaya ka prayog bimariyon ko paida hone se pehle hi rok deta hai.
Mansik swasthya bhi utna hi zaroori hai — doston se baat karna, khelna aur pasand ka kaam karna man ko swasth aur khush rakhta hai.
Aam galti: antibiotic ko har bukhar-sardi ki dawa samajhna; ye sirf jivanuon par kaam karti hai, virus se hone wale jukam par nahi — doctor ki salah zaroori hai.

title: Swasthya: Sabse Bada Khazana
